findings.message: Unsupported: No continuous effect or PlayerRestriction says "can't lose life". CantGainLife is the other half, and LifeTotalChanges also forbids gaining life, which this line allows.

Unsupported: No record grants hexproof to a player. Player-scoped abilities have their own records (PlayerProtectionFromEverything, CantLoseGame), and there is none for hexproof; PlayerCant with BeTargeted would forbid every spell and ability targeting that player, while hexproof only stops those an opponent controls.
